question: For whom and over what time is the practice of the bondage-free ochre robe enjoined?
premises: A relative clause identifies a person who should practice.
The practice is to be undertaken from six months onward.
The object of practice is the ochre robe described as free from bondage.
inference: One who practices should do so from six months onward with regard to the bondage-free ochre robe.
uncertainties: The precise meaning of practicing the robe is not specified here.
plain_english: One who indeed should practice from six months onward the ochre robe free from bondage.
